name: Reserve Bank of India — press releases RSS
access: HTTPS GET to www.rbi.org.in/pressreleases_rss.xml (RSS 2.0); no key

rate_limit.source: No request-rate policy found on https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/Disclaimer.aspx or https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/rss.aspx (2026-10-23). Self-imposed polite pacing: one request every 5 s, one poll every 15 min.

failure_behavior: Connection errors, 429 or 5xx: bounded exponential backoff, then the source's run is recorded FAILED; stored items remain with their first-seen times.
verdict_reason: RBI publishes the feed for subscription; no clause found that forbids automated reading of it. The feed's <copyright> names the Reserve Bank, and the disclaimer requires permission before hyper-linking to or framing internal pages from another web site. Use is limited to the owner's private reading in this terminal: headline, link, time and a summary cut to 600 characters (the feed's description carries the whole release, which is not republished); no redistribution, no public web page linking.

datasets.description: RBI press releases (headline, link, publication time; the description holds the full release as HTML, stored only as a 600-character plain-text summary)
datasets.update_frequency: as releases are published (polled every 15 min)
datasets.availability_rule: first_seen receipt time; the feed's pubDate is kept as the publication time. The feed's pubDate has no zone (e.g. 'Fri, 23 Oct 2026 19:25:00'); it is read as Asia/Kolkata and each item is flagged time_zone_assumed:Asia/Kolkata
datasets.rights_source: https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/Disclaimer.aspx and the feed's own <copyright> element (Copyright Reserve Bank of India)
